note: Local tier ladder defined by this library. Not an industry certification; tier-5 is not a defect-freedom claim.

controls.C1: Reproducible build from a clean checkout with pinned dependencies
controls.C2: Automated tests for every claimed behaviour
controls.C3: Failure-path tests: malformed input, limits, partial failure, timeout
controls.C4: Fuzz or property tests on externally influenced input
controls.C7: Resource bounds and leak checks with measured ceilings
controls.C8: Static analysis with no unresolved high-severity findings
controls.C9: Measured performance against a stated budget
controls.C11: Input trust boundaries, allowlists and secret handling
controls.C12: Observability: logs, metrics, traces, alerts mapped to runbooks
controls.C13: Operational readiness: runbook, tested rollback, owner, rehearsed restore
controls.C14: Independent review and named human sign-off
controls.C15: Legal, privacy, accessibility and safety review

rules: reported tier = min(score-derived tier, gate-derived tier)
an unknown control status yields evidence-incomplete and no tier
a tier label applies to one revision under one evidence set only
